visualCharacteristics.structure: image + text + heading + link + table + list
visualCharacteristics.purpose: editorial article: hero with background image and title card, then the article body card with headings, text, lists, tables, images and inline promo banners

contentPattern.structure: row 1: hero image cell | text cell (eyebrow, H1 title, date / read time, optional CTA link); following one-cell rows: article body content in order; following multi-cell rows: inline promo banner (text | CTA | logo)

usage: Personal banking guide, credit card and lending learning-center articles.
reuseGuidance: Use for long-form article pages. image gives a taller hero, alt bolds the first table column, alt-2 lets tables size to their content. Related-articles and additional-resources sections are separate blocks.
